title: Saaqi Altash
body:
ay saqi babul hawaej ay sakina ke chacha
zainab o kulsoom ki chadar haram ka aasra
ay jari tum fatema zehra ke dil ki ho dua
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon ki aas ho tum to abbas ho
pyase bachon ke labon par hai nauha pyaas ka
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hai jaah o hasham uska rakho bharam
karti hai ye buka binte shaah e umam
aaya honton pe dam ye lo mashk o alam
ye na ho pyaas se mar jaye pyase be khata
mere pyare chacha abal fazlil abbas
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunlo ay bawafa al atash ki sada
shiddat se pyaas ki jeena mushkil hua
kooze haathon mein hai aur lab pe ilteja
pani le aao is se pehle ke aaye qaza
mere pyare chacha abal fazlil abbas
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
lashkar e ashqiyan ghere hai alqama
teen din hogaye pani nahi mila
ghar ko aaya nahi maqtal ko jo gaya
tum to khyber kusha ke laal ho jao zara
mere pyare chacha abal fazlil abbas
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hi din bhar gaye sadme de kar gaye
zainab ke laadle bhaiya akbar gaye
sheh par hone fida aun o jafar gaye
tum hi ho paas tum se aas hai ay bawafa
mere pyare chacha abal fazlil abbas
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho sookhi zaban ay meer e karwan
tum se bole nahi to phir jaaye kahan
zulmat ki dhoop hai aur tum ho sayeban
tum to is dashte bala mein ho sab ka aasra
mere pyare chacha abal fazlil abbas
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sun ke aah o buka ghazi e bawafa
le ke mashk o alam darya ko chal diya
sheh ne thaami kamar zainab ne ki dua
mere mabood zindabad rahe ye sada
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
pahuncha wo bawafa wo cheeni alqama
mashkeeza bhar liya qaimon ko chal diya
chid gayi teer se mashk pani baha
girte dekha jo alam sheh ne kiya marsiya
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kar ke fida ghode se jab gira
girte hi khaak par aaqa ko di sada
pahunche shahe umam laashe pe ki buka
mujhko ek baar kaho bhai mere bawafa
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza ne di khabar bibiyon peeto sar
tha jis ka aasra sogaya nehr par
pyase ghash kha gaye ro diye behrobar
qaimon mein mazhar o irfan ye kohraam tha
saaqi altash ay abal fazlil abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
do laashe aise hai qaimon mein nahi aaye
ek laasha sarwar ka ek laasha ghazi ka
author: Mazhar Abidi
